### 🟢 Approval recommended The focused change preserves successful-response behavior and aligns async failures with existing synchronous behavior, with no blocking issues identified. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR This PR aligns `AzureAISearchRetriever` async error handling with the synchronous path, preventing non-200 responses from surfacing as misleading `KeyError: 'value'` errors. **Changes:** - Check response status before parsing JSON in both async session branches. - Add sync and async error-response regression tests. - Extract an async session mock helper with an explicit response status. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `libs/​azure-ai/​tests/​unit_tests/​test_azure_ai_search_retriever.py` | Adds error-response tests and a reusable async session mock. | | `libs/​azure-ai/​langchain_azure_ai/​retrievers/​azure_ai_search.py` | Raises on non-200 responses in both async search branches. |
Review effort: Balanced
